messages:
tess: opened a docs PR to add compatibility notes and a short SDK routing example for CPU-quantized variants of polaris-13b. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5821

 t ess: tl;dr: q4_cpu variants don't support KV cache / on-GPU attention for long-context streaming. users saw silent fallbacks to a disk-cache variant which changed latency and token billing unexpectedly. need three small changes: (1) add a compatibility row in polaris-13b model card; (2) include a short bench note (p95 latency numbers for q4_cpu vs full fp16 at 2048 context); (3) a tiny SDK snippet showing how to prefer the full model for streaming (routing hint) and how to detect fallback in the client.

 n otes: tiny PR, mostly copy edits 

 rory: runtime context: correct — CPU-quantized builds run with a disabled KV-cache path to avoid OOM when mapping large KV tables into host memory. fallback path streams through the disk-cache worker which is slower and billed differently. We added a metric (kernel.fallback_reason) last quarter that surfaces this, so we can link to that in the card.

 li: bench numbers I ran this morning: at ctx=2048, p95 tokens/sec: q4_cpu: 1.8 t/s, fp16-full: 7.4 t/s. p95 latency per token: q4_cpu ~ 560ms, fp16 ~ 135ms. I'll paste a short table for the model card.

 tess: pasted bench table into the PR under a new section "compatibility & performance notes". also added a single-line anchor but lint flagged duplicate anchor that collides with the global catalog anchors.

 lint-bot: WARNING docs/models/polaris-13b.md: anchor "compatibility-performance-notes" already defined in docs/models/nebula-3b.md line 12.

 nina: for anchors, prefer model-scoped anchors like "polaris13b-compat-performance". can you rename to that and keep the heading short? I'll help with the commit.

 tess: updated — anchor renamed and pushed. also added an example snippet for the Python SDK that shows routing hints and runtime detection:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
# prefer the full model for streaming to avoid disk-cache fallback
resp = client.generate(
    model="polaris-13b",
    input="<long prefix...>",
    routing={"prefer_variant": "fp16-full", "allow_fallback": True}
)
# detect fallback from the response metadata
if resp.metadata.get("runtime.fallback"):
    print("Warning: response was served by a fallback variant; latency/billing may differ")
```

 tess: added a second tiny JS snippet that shows how to check event metadata in streaming:```js
const client = new RedwoodClient()
const stream = await client.stream({ model: 'polaris-13b' })
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  if (chunk.meta && chunk.meta['runtime.fallback']) {
    console.warn('fallback variant used — consider routing hints')
  }
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

 rory: runtime suggestion: change the field to kernel.fallback_reason in docs (that's what the tracing emits). also note the specific variant names that may exhibit fallback: polaris-13b-q4_cpu, polaris-13b-q4_cpu-smallmap. Add a short compatibility line: "KV cache: not supported on q4_cpu variants — streaming may fallback to disk-cache worker."

 tess: updated wording per rory; added the variant list. also linked to the kernel metric docs and the catalog fallback table.

 sam: product note — please add one sentence in the model card about billing differences (hosted customers see per-token billing unchanged but observed tail-latency impact; dedicated customers may hit capacity limits). short sentence sufficient.

 tess: added a one-sentence billing callout.

 lint-bot: re-run: no anchor duplicates, small markdown lint warning: line length in docs/models/polaris-13b.md line 84.

 docs-bot: preview deployed for PR #5821 — https://deploy-preview.docs/5821 — view the polaris card under "compatibility & performance notes".

 nina: i'll smoke test snippets in node and python. quick sanity check: update the SDK doc string for routing.prefer_variant so examples are consistent.

 tess: done. assigning follow-ups: @nina smoke, @rory add kernel metric link to runtime changelog, @li confirm bench table formatting, @sam approve billing sentence.

 nina: smoke: python snippet runs locally and the metadata key appears as kernel.fallback_reason. JS snippet works in local smoke but streaming client needs a small polyfill for for-await-of in older node. leaving a tiny note in the examples.

 sam: LGTM on billing sentence. approving PR.

 rory: I'll add the runtime changelog line after this merges.

 tess: thanks everyone — merging now. will tag the release notes and close the PR. will follow up with a small doc update if we rename the metric later.
